characterDescription: A minimal overlay-style navigation that dissolves into the content — positioned absolute with large paddingInline, invisible background, and a letterSpacing of 0.08em that gives nav labels a spare, architectural quality. Hover fades to 0.75 opacity for a deferential, editorial touch rather than a directional underline.

_twist.description: Letter spacing on nav links at intensity 3: 0.08em added to typography.letterSpacing. Font family updated to Syne (matching type-system assembly). Hover link style updated to opacity 0.2s ease-in-out (aligned with interaction-states twist).
